string-array.item: Improves the recent sets chart with more visibility of the effort curve
Display refresh with new Material guidelines
Fixes a bug in copy day that would modify the prescribed sets and reps
Sending a workout to your garmin watch now provides weight suggestions
Garmin watches will no longer allow recording more sets than the day prescribes
Pair a Garmin watch to run your workout from your wrist: send today\'s plan, complete sets and rest right there, and it all syncs back to your phone automatically, even through a dropped connection
